# Mika Spark Studio

> Mika Spark Studio is a solo indie development studio based in Nagano, Japan, run by developer MiKa. Tagline: "Small ideas, turned into products you can actually use." It designs, builds, tests, publishes, and operates its own iOS apps and games with no employees. Contact: support@mikaspark.com

## Products

- [Uzmera](https://uzmera.mikaspark.com/): A music practice app for iOS for wind and brass players. Record practice takes, layer multitrack recordings, and compare performances side by side. Includes a tuner and metronome (landscape mode designed for external microphones). Free with ads; the one-time "Uzmera Plus" upgrade (¥490) removes ads and unlocks unlimited takes, 8-track recording, high-quality audio, and WAV export. Currently in preparation for release on the App Store.
- [Hirame](https://mikaspark.com/works/hirame/): An idea-training app for iOS that builds creative thinking through constraints. Available on the App Store.
- [A Witch's Life (まほうのある暮らし)](https://mahou.mikaspark.com/): A browser game about quietly living the life of a witch. Free to play in the browser.
- [Uzume-chan LINE Stickers](https://line.me/S/sticker/37956024): A set of 16 pixel-art stickers of Uzume-chan, the studio mascot, sold on the LINE Store for ¥190.

## Free BGM — FLUTE & CO.

- [Free BGM download page](https://mikaspark.com/free-bgm/): Free background music by FLUTE & CO., a jazz project led by the flute, published by Mika Spark Studio. Tracks may be used as background music in videos, live streams, and podcasts, including monetized content, free of charge with credit. Re-uploading tracks on their own, using them in music compilations, and selling or redistributing the music itself are not allowed.
- Vol.1 "A Day in a Port Town" (10 tracks, 27 minutes, flute and piano jazz / bossa nova): Before the Town Wakes; Sunlight on the Pavement; Sunlight on the Patio; Terrace at Noon; Coastal Veranda; Salt and Sun; Salts and Keys; Tide Below the Pier; Harbor Reflections; Beneath the Cedar Bough. All tracks were composed with Google Gemini (Lyria) and contain AI-generated music.
- [FLUTE & CO. on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@FluteAndCo)
